entries.text: A `DatabaseConfig`, such as the one `PlatformHookRegistry.build_database_config` returns, no longer shows secrets when it is printed, formatted or logged. Its `repr`, `str` and log output redact secret-named options and fields (`password`, `token`, `secret`, `api_key`, `connection_string` and similar) and the credentials embedded in URIs, while the connection code still reads the real values. Before, a Snowflake config built from saved credentials printed the password in full. A test-session probe seeds a sentinel credential in the caller's home and checks that an isolated pytest run never reads it and writes nothing to that home; a live-only run still reads it.
